summary.scene: TEST_ONLY: A newly completed 10 ft wide by 20 ft long by 10 ft high eastward hallway connects via a centered open 5-ft doorway to the 20x20x10-ft Survey Alcove. Beneath the disused station near Teri, F4, the core remains in its cradle; Sparky is still under instructions to remain in the Survey Alcove. The survey-marked iron-bearing seam has not been mined.
